scoring_justification: The headline quantities are the final outputs of a full simulation that the verifier sandbox cannot re-run; result-level comparison against hidden reference values with tolerances is the appropriate tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference doping-dependent Tc(p) and isotope shift alpha(p) curves derived from the paper's empirical formula and model description.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Fig. 4 and empirical formula: Tc = Tc_max*(1-82.6*(p-p0)^2), p0=0.162, Tc_max=193 K. Alpha shape approximated as a V-shaped dip with minimum near p0 and rising to 0.55.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived directly from the paper's reported formulas and model results; ensures the checker evaluates the agent's numerical solution of the FBM gap equation and dCDW free-energy minimization consistent with the paper's predictions.

outputs.description: Doping-dependent superconducting transition temperature and oxygen isotope shift exponent.
Magnitude of the d-wave CDW gap from free-energy minimization.
Ratio of the r.m.s. dCDW quadrupolar amplitude to the zero-point vibrational amplitude.

output_contract.notes: This task reproduces key predictions of a microscopic model for high-Tc superconductivity. The Tc and isotope shift curves should exhibit a hump and a dip near optimal doping, respectively. The dCDW gap and amplitude ratio are scalar values consistent with the model parameters.
